notes.title: 📢 Patch Notes – Version 1.1.2
notes.content:
[b][EN] – Bug Fixes & Quality Improvements[/b]

This patch focuses on solving key gameplay issues and improving user experience:

[b]Fixes & Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] ✅ Fixed bug preventing interaction with certain buttons.
[*] 🔇 Decreased error sound volume during incorrect sequences.
[*]  ⎋   Pause menu can now be closed with the Escape key.
[*] 🌲 Fixed trees appearing in front of the player unexpectedly.
[*] 👾 Fixed enemy getting stuck on the fence.
[*] 🏃 Increased player stamina for better movement flow.
[/list]

Thanks for your continued feedback—your support keeps the game evolving!

notes.title: 🕯️ Thank you for being here – What’s next and how to help
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]We just want to say thank you for the support [i]In The Dark[/i] has received during these first days.[/p][p]We’re a small team (just a few friends), and every wishlist, comment or message means a lot to us.[/p][p]We’ve already started work on [b]Chapter 2[/b], and we’re also making some polish passes on Chapter 1: sound design, lighting, and visual feedback.[/p][p]If you’ve already played the game and enjoyed it, sharing it with someone who loves psychological horror would help more than you imagine.[/p][p]And if you feel like leaving a short review, even a sentence, it would truly support us from within the Steam ecosystem.[/p][p]Thank you for stepping into the dark. This journey is just beginning.[/p][p]— The [i]In The Dark[/i] team[/p]

notes.title: 🔥 Last minute: 40% launch discount ends tomorrow!
notes.content: [p]Hello, horror gamers! 👁️‍🗨️[/p][p]I'm the developer of In The Dark, and I want to sincerely thank you for the support I've received in this first week.[/p][p]This project was created by a very small group of people with tremendous dedication, and the response has been incredible.[/p][p][b]⚠️ The 40% discount ends tomorrow, July 18th.[/b] If you enjoy psychological horror, unexpected scares, and tense exploration, I invite you to try it today.[/p][p]Every purchase directly helps me develop Chapter 2, with more mechanics, story, and scares.[/p][p]🕯️ Thank you for joining me in the darkness![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes – Version 1.1
notes.content: [p][b]Language Update & Minor Fixes[/b][/p][p]We're happy to announce the first patch for "[i]A Warm Smile"[/i]. This update introduces two new languages and some minor improvements:[/p][p][b]New:[/b][/p][list][*][p]🌍 Spanish (Español) and Portuguese (Português) are now available![/p][/*][*][p]Language selector added to the main menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Minor menu adjustments.[/p][/*][*][p]Small text alignment issues resolved.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re continuing to listen to your feedback. [b]Thank you for supporting the game![/b][/p]

notes.title: Development Roadmap for this future months
notes.content: [p]A journey into the unknown...[/p][p]We're taking our time to build a terrifying and immersive experience. Here's what you can expect over the coming months:[/p][p]🔹 [b]Release[/b] – Chapter One: [i]A Warm Smile[/i] (English only) 🔹 [b]Halloween Update[/b] – More languages, creepy decorations, menu overhaul, and community features 🔹 [b]Christmas Update[/b] – Seasonal visuals, new note inventory, better audio control, and deeper lore 🔹 [b]Coming Next[/b] – Chapter 2: [i]Echoes in the Dark[/i], expanded story, performance improvements, and devlogs[/p][p]Your feedback helps shape the future of the game—thank you for being part of it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599559/288608513eb3b6d03d23b910d6d2010d7b5189b7.png"][/img][/p]
